title: Conditional κ = 0.00302728823 (+3.823e-8 over #5392): direct backward caller
body:
This conditional construction gives **κ = 302728823/100000000000 = 0.00302728823**, a gain of **0.00000551243** over the selected final [PR #4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610). A direct caller wrapper lets all 18 full calls use the completed backward supplier. The local circuit and its eight owned relations remain unchanged.

**Concurrent result:** [PR #5392](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5392) reached the same recursive profile by circuit transposition during this work. This package gives a distinct direct conjugation that does not transpose the circuit. Its κ exceeds that PR's 0.00302725 by **0.00000003823**, but that increment comes from compiler headroom. It is **not another paid-profile hill-climbing step beyond PR #5392**. The two constructions have the same fixed-profile ceiling.

The [proof and complete bill](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/174fb211493b43a42210434083e9702b4fb7a2ce/research/kappa-backward-controller-20261023/README.md), [literal caller](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/174fb211493b43a42210434083e9702b4fb7a2ce/research/kappa-backward-controller-20261023/CONTROLLER.json), [exact result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/174fb211493b43a42210434083e9702b4fb7a2ce/research/kappa-backward-controller-20261023/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/174fb211493b43a42210434083e9702b4fb7a2ce/research/kappa-backward-controller-20261023/verify.py) and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/174fb211493b43a42210434083e9702b4fb7a2ce/research/kappa-backward-controller-20261023/SOURCES.json) define the review object. The branch starts at canonical main `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`, priority revision 7. It adds one isolated package.

For the normalized source interfaces, `F_s = R B_s R^-1`, where `R = [[0,1],[-Q^-2,0]]`. Execute a signed swap and Q-squared translation, the unchanged complete backward supplier, then the inverse wrapper. Both Q-squared powers are exact native translations. Scalar minus signs stay outside tensor powers. The wrapper acts only on the main fields; the 400 independent helper outputs and all 17 owned returns use the existing backward contract. This argument works from that complete contract and needs no instruction transposition theorem.

This consumes the [eight-relation proof and supplier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e/research/kappa-joint-relations-20261023/README.md) in [PR #5383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5383), frozen at `4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e`. The two copied runtime files are byte-exact and retained in this branch's ancestor `9078033224509f184e3da4ccfd9837d1e1ad314e`. The reconstructed local word must match the published payload SHA256 `2aee5e997df99726fc763e510d9cb69fbe4f86114dc8d2cd33ad26c6c462a21d`. Eleven external runtime inputs come from the recorded main base. A clean replay needs no separate pending-PR fetch.

Relative to [PR #5383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5383), the caller removes **16 H1 and 16 H8 paid jobs**, with **16 H9 productive targets debited**. The strict moment gain is `16(1+8^t-9^t)>0` for `0<t<1`. The complete bill has **64,116 paid calls and 10,784 productive fields**, with rank surplus 752. All 15 query shears, all whole idles, both boundary programs, main targets, helper losses, storage and completion tails are included. The added scalar/translation allowance is 459,648; the complete raw nonrecursive allowance is **181,586,816 < 10^9**. The three-ADD swap has a fixed intermediate norm factor of at most two, which the full-template precision contract must include.

Two rational interval engines enclose the crossing in **(0.00302728824993, 0.00302728824994)**. The stated κ leaves more than `1.993e-11` raw headroom. Tested saving 0.00302728824, reserve `1e-12`, both charged tails, finite compiler and all 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates pass. The compiler threshold is `N = 2^38569300000000000`; its expanded word is not materialized. This larger threshold funds the smaller gap.

With CPython 3.12 and the standard library, run:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/kappa-backward-controller-20261023
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/kappa-backward-controller-20261023
```

Both registered mathematical replays must print:

```text
PASS_CONDITIONAL_KAPPA_00302728823_ALL_BACKWARD_CONTROLLER
```

Registered normal and optimized replays passed on CPython 3.12.13; direct author replay passed on CPython 3.14.7. The checks cover all 624 retained and 17 arbitrary owned input columns, sixteen unrestricted source identities, **896 actual native contacts and 114,688 literal central-square columns at stages 0 and 32**, the full Laurent caller, two complete invoices, two interval engines and the complete bound. Seven native, four caller and seven cost/outer controls reject corrupted relations, ownership, phases, orientations, helper credit, reserves and outer parameters. All 22 committed-file bindings and official export integrity pass. Both read-only Git-free replays pass, with all 23 exported files unchanged. Hosted CI is separate and is not claimed here.

The [five selected framework assumptions](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4/docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr4610/PROOF-REVIEW.md) remain: native all-column realization, owned erasure, uniform compiler closure, precision/tape and analytic recovery. Full source phase lowering and amplitudes, ordinary BIT native construction, physical tape and numerical precision execution, analytic decomposition, prime avoidance and integer recovery are inherited, not freshly executed. No Lean, Docker, proof-kernel acceptance or independent human approval is claimed. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout. The selected frontier is unchanged.
